records.text: Perceived power, money, influence, A-listers, connections to the media PR world up against truth. And what this case proved was that truth wins. So congratulations, Justin Baldoni. Congratulations, Melissa Nathan. Congratulations, Bryan Freedman. Congratulations to the TikTokers that did this thing. There were so many TikTokers. I feel like we should have an award ceremony where we just give ourselves awards for this one.
